description: This file defines GDB Python extensions for debugging PyTorch, including commands to display human-readable representations of tensors, IntArrayRef, and DispatchKeyset, and a context manager to disable breakpoints during evaluation.

classes.name: DisableBreakpoints
classes.description: Context manager to temporarily disable all gdb breakpoints during evaluation.

classes.name: TensorRepr
classes.description: GDB command to print a human-readable representation of at::Tensor.

classes.name: IntArrayRefRepr
classes.description: GDB command to print a human-readable representation of c10::IntArrayRef.

classes.name: DispatchKeysetRepr
classes.description: GDB command to print a human-readable representation of c10::DispatchKeyset.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GDB command with its name and command type.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the command logic to evaluate and print the respective object representation.
